answer: Before first payout, the holder links a university degree, its number and one signed transcript. Two verifiers match both against the university registry in a week; a degree claimed twice, or no record on file, closes both. A degree costs 50,000,000 rupiah in tuition, so one graduate pays once while a thousand fakes need a thousand degrees and 50 billion. The graduate's voyage ends at the horizon, pearl-white certificate in hand.
